name: OcLaneForecaster
description: Pre-dispatch run-duration prediction, shape classification (work-loop, slow ops), lane cap early warnings, and lane event telemetry

warningThresholdRatio.description: Threshold ratio of lane cap at which to warn (e.g. 0.85 * 600s = 510s)

enableTelemetry.description: Whether to emit lane event forecast telemetry
